requirements.title: STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE has the specified status value semantics
requirements.definition: STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE is a default integer scalar constant. The value of STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE is positive. It is assigned to STAT variables or arguments for synchronization or collective-subroutine interactions with an image that initiated normal termination.

pending.STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE-default-integer-scala: Assign STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE to an integer initialized to -777; assert KIND(value)==KIND(0) and RANK(value)==0. Mutate the imported name to STAT_FAILED_IMAGE.
pending.STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE-positive-value: Assert STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE > 0 using an integer sentinel initialized to -777. Mutate the comparison to STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE < 0.
